causalSequence: boil salted water; cook fettuccine al dente; reserve some pasta water
crisp bacon in pan (garlic added in 3 of 4 sources); set aside
whisk eggs (whole or yolks) with grated cheese; cream joins the whisk in cream-style versions
toss hot drained pasta through egg mix off the heat so residual heat sets sauce without scrambling
loosen with reserved pasta water; season with pepper
serve immediately topped with extra cheese
